title: Reading layered traffic-light drawing
description: You can inspect drawing order and vertical placement in the supplied example.

steps.description: You create the Traffic Light window and its canvas. The first shape is the dark-gray housing rectangle.
Each oval follows a fill-color setting. The supplied red and yellow lights share their x coordinate and dimensions.

steps.question: Does the green light's larger y coordinate place it above or below the other lights?
steps.answer: It places the green light below them because screen y coordinates increase downward.

steps.description: The tutorial describes red, yellow and green circles stacked inside the housing. You end with wait to keep the window open; the recording supplies no text output.
